description: This file defines the PdfCrossReferenceTable class, which manages the cross-reference table of a PDF document, including adding, removing, renumbering, and traversing object references within the PDF structure.

classes.name: PdfCrossReferenceTable
classes.description: Manages the cross-reference table of a PDF document, handling object references, addition, removal, renumbering, and traversal of indirect objects.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a PdfReference to the cross-reference table, assigning a new object ID if necessary.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a PdfObject to the cross-reference table, assigning a new object ID if necessary.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add a PdfObject to the table if it is not already present.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a PdfReference from the table.

methods.name: GetNewObjectNumber
methods.description: Returns the next available object number for new objects.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the cross-reference table into PDF format.

methods.name: AllObjectIDs
methods.description: Returns all object IDs in the table, for debugging.

methods.name: AllReferences
methods.description: Returns all cross-references sorted by object ID.

methods.name: HandleOrphanedReferences
methods.description: Placeholder for handling orphaned references (not implemented).

methods.name: Compact
methods.description: Removes unreachable objects from the table, returning the count of removed objects.

methods.name: GetPositionOfObjectBehind
methods.description: Finds the position of the object immediately behind a given object.

methods.name: CheckConsistence
methods.description: Debug method to verify internal consistency of the reference table.

methods.name: TransitiveClosure
methods.description: Computes all indirectly reachable objects from a given PdfObject.
